scope: First safe microlot of the BANK36 mission/episode description table: seven pointer-delimited two-line descriptions at 0x365248..0x3653C7.

consumer_proof.pointer_table: BANK36 table begins at 0x3651B4. BANK3A code around ROM 0x3A8575 doubles the selected index, loads far pointer 6000:51B4 via LES from CS:8590, adds the index and reads the uint16 description offset.
consumer_proof.table_shape: 49 uint16 entries at 0x3651B4..0x365215: entry 0=0xB010; entries 1..48 point to 0x5248..0x5BC2. The seven E5 records are entries 1..7 and therefore independently addressable.
consumer_proof.renderer_budget: The final locked placeholder at 0x365BC2 is 16 fullwidth glyphs + CRLF + 16 fullwidth glyphs, supporting a 16-glyph-per-line presentation budget. E5 keeps every line <=16 glyphs.

protected_boundary.reason: Next pointer-delimited record contains embedded control 00 15 between its first text fragment and CRLF; intentionally left byte-identical for separate control analysis.

route_qa: Static pointer/slot QA complete; bounded Mesen boot smoke test to be recorded separately. Exact mission-list route not naturally forced in this phase.
